pattern.short_summary: Rather than an always-on stream, the system packages interaction into episodes with a defined opening and close.
pattern.definition: Rather than an always-on stream, the system packages interaction into episodes with a defined opening and close. Each session covers a bounded slice of material and ends; the next session is a new episode rather than a continuation of the same thread. The boundary is imposed by the system, not by the user walking away.
pattern.structural_signature: Control flow is a repeated cycle with an entry condition and a terminal state: material is admitted at session start, processed through a fixed internal flow, and the session closes, after which no further turns belong to it. Session boundaries are visible as flow-diagram endpoints and as scoping for what the system may reference. Transplants to any continuous process that could have been left running — monitoring, tutoring, journaling, review.

dimension.category_description: When assistance appears and who triggers it: system-initiated, continuous, deferred, session-bound, or explicitly summoned.
dimension.classification_boundary: The timing or trigger must be observable in the interaction; surface placement alone belongs to U09.
